items.head: The weekend reward meal
items.sub: Tight all week, then burger, wings, dessert. Week erased.

items.head: 8 to 10 drinks on Saturday
items.sub: Wrecks sleep, recovery and Sunday. Cut it in half.

items.head: Break room grazing
items.sub: Donuts, cake, the candy bowl. A few hundred calories a day.

items.head: Drive-thru lunch
items.sub: A footlong sub alone can clear 1,000 calories.

label: KILLER 5
head: Late-night screen snacking
sub: Not hungry, just decompressing. And it costs you sleep.

text: Ask what the food is for. *A reward, a release or a break?*
